title: Failed automatic charges in Collections
problem: A failed bKash or card charge was hidden in one bill's history until the bill went overdue.
now: Collections has an Auto-charge failed group with Retry now and Ask owner to update payment method, which logs it and sends the store a notice.
steps: Open Collections: Mehedi Traders is under Auto-charge failed
Press Retry now and read the result
From the row's menu choose Ask owner to update payment method
Open the bill to see each try in its timeline
notes: Where: Super admin: Billing & credits › Collections (/admin/collections) · Needs the server: The retry result is a demo; a live build calls bKash or the card gateway.
